phrases.latin: In ahēnum caldum unguen inditō. Singulōs aut bīnōs coquitō versātōque crēbrō duābus rudibus, coctōs eximitō.
phrases.english: Put fat into a hot pan. Fry them one or two at a time, turning them often with two spoons, and take them out when done.
We’ll deep-fry the fish in plenty of oil.

phrases.latin: Oleī modicum in sartāginem mitte; tum cēpam concīsam leviter frīge.
phrases.english: Put a little oil in the pan; then fry the chopped onion gently.

phrases.latin: Piscēs quālēslibet cūrātōs frīgēs, in patinam compōnēs
phrases.english: Fry any kind of fish, cleaned, and arrange them in a dish
Shall I fry you an egg?
